955:
Penélope Cruz Sánchez (born 28 April 1974) is a Spanish actress. Prolific in Spanish and English-language films, her accolades include an Academy Award, a BAFTA Award, a David di Donatello and three Goya Awards.

Cruz made her television acting debut at age 16, and her feature film debut the following year in Jamón Jamón (1992). Her subsequent roles included Belle Époque (1992), Open Your Eyes (1997), Don Juan (1998), The Hi-Lo Country (1999), The Girl of Your Dreams (2000) and Woman on Top (2000).
1723: Walter Wesley Hill (born January 10, 1942) is an American filmmaker. Hill is known for male-dominated action films and revival of the Western. He said in an interview, "Every film I've done has been a Western," and elaborated in another, "The Western is ultimately a stripped down moral universe that is, whatever the dramatic problems are, beyond the normal avenues of social control and social alleviation of the problem, and I like to do that even within contemporary stories."
1979: Kevin Spacey Fowler KBE (born July 26, 1959) is an American actor, producer, and singer. He began his career as a stage actor during the 1980s, obtaining supporting roles in film and television. Spacey's first roles in film were in Mike Nichols' Heartburn (1986), and Working Girl (1988). He gained critical acclaim in the 1990s, with an Academy Award for Best Supporting Actor for the neo-noir crime thriller The Usual Suspects (1995) and an Academy Award for Best Actor for the midlife-crisis-themed drama American Beauty (1999).
8891:
John Joseph Travolta (born February 18, 1954) is an American actor. He began acting on television before transitioning into a leading man in film. His accolades include a Primetime Emmy Award, three Golden Globe Awards, and nominations for two Academy Awards, a British Academy Film Award, and three Screen Actors Guild Awards.

Travolta came to prominence starring in the sitcom Welcome Back, Kotter (1975–1979), followed by leading roles in Carrie (1976), Grease (1978), Urban Cowboy (1980), and Blow Out (1981). He earned nominations for the Academy Award for Best Actor for his roles in Saturday Night Fever (1977) and Pulp Fiction (1994).
23227:
Steven Knight (born 5 August 1959) is a British screenwriter, producer, and director for film and television. He wrote the screenplays for the films Closed Circuit, Dirty Pretty Things, and Eastern Promises. Also, he wrote and directed the films Locke and Hummingbird (a.k.a. Redemption). In July 2025, it was announced that he would write the 26th official James Bond film, to be directed by Denis Villeneuve.

Knight is one of three creators of Who Wants to Be a Millionaire?, a game show that has been remade and aired in around 160 countries worldwide.
81851: Emi Shinohara (born Emiko Shinohara on August 8, 1963) was a Japanese voice actress employed by 81 Produce. She was born in Fukushima Prefecture and raised in Nagano. She is married to tokusatsu actor Hiroshi Watari. She's known for playing Sailor Jupiter in the original Sailor Moon anime.
116923: Trivikram Srinivas is an Indian film director, screenwriter and dialogue writer renowned for his work in Telugu cinema. He is celebrated for his witty dialogues, philosophical undercurrents and emotionally resonant family dramas. Starting out as a dialogue writer on hits like Swayamvaram (1999), Nuvve Kavali (2000), Nuvvu Naaku Nachav (2001), Manmadhudu (2002) and Malliswari (2004), he transitioned to directing with Nuvve Nuvve (2002) and went on to make acclaimed and commercially successful films such as Athadu (2005), Jalsa (2008), Julayi (2012), Atharintiki Daaredi (2013), S/O Satyamurthy (2015) , A Aa (2016) and Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo (2020).
550843:
Elizabeth Chase Olsen (born February 16, 1989) is an American actress. Known for her roles in blockbusters and independent dramas, she has received nominations for a BAFTA Award, an Emmy Award, and two Golden Globe Awards.

Born in Los Angeles, Olsen began acting at age four alongside her sisters Mary-Kate and Ashley Olsen. She made her film debut in the thriller Martha Marcy May Marlene (2011), which earned praise. She then took on roles in the horror film Silent House (2012) and the action film Godzilla(2014), received a nomination for the BAFTA Rising Star Award, and graduated from New York University.
584123: Chinni Jayanth is an Indian film director, producer, comedian, actor and mimicry artist who has appeared in many main, character and supporting roles in Tamil films.
610747: Hindi film producer and director. Along with Manmohan Desai, Prakash Mehra was regarded as the pioneer of "Masala" film genre. His collaboration with the actor Amitabh Bachchan resulted in several box office blockbusters and classics, due to which Mehra was considered among the 'Golden Directors' of his time.
968635: Barun Chanda (born 30 May) is an Indian advertising professional, actor and author based in the city of Kolkata. He is mostly remembered for his role in Satyajit Ray's Seemabaddha. He portrayed the role of Jawaharlal Nehru in Anik Duttaʼs Aparajito (2022).
1020859: Sung Dong-il is a South Korean actor. Sung made his acting debut in theater in 1987, then was recruited at the 1991 SBS open talent auditions.
2139323: Raihan Rafi Chowdhury is a popular Bangladeshi filmmaker. He made his directorial debut in the year 2018 with the film 'Poramon 2'. Later in the same year he released his second film 'Dohon' under the same banner and having the same cast in the lead roles. Rafi has created several short films too specifically for some OTT platforms. In 2020 he released his first web film 'Janowar' in the OTT platform 'Cinematic', followed by two more web films in 2021 for different OTT platforms.
